provenance.ballPolicy: Moxie-specific separate ball is carried through the layup gather, reaches her open right hand at the frame4/tick9 release, then follows through above the rim. No ball is drawn into the source.

review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct complete human layup poses. Moxie’s pale face, lavender eyes, long high ponytail/gold tie, purple/silver kit and shoes remain consistent. She approaches, rises, extends one empty hand at the frame4/tick9 layup release, follows through and lands. No ball is drawn.
